ITEM 1 | Dark purple-black oval olives, glossy and smooth-skinned, about 10 whole pieces clustered on the left side of the plate, each roughly 1.5 cm long, slightly wrinkled skin, no visible pits or cuts | 35
ITEM 2 | Rectangular block of baked dish with a bubbled, golden-orange browned top and creamy white interior, slightly glossy, holds its shape, about 6 cm by 4 cm and roughly 2 cm thick, with reddish-orange sauce streaks over the surface | 150
ITEM 3 | Pale tan-brown grain mixture (rice-like) with visible grains and a few darker bits, moist and slightly clumped, spread in a crescent along the upper right of the plate, about 8 cm by 3 cm and 1 cm high | 70
ITEM 4 | Pinkish-brown shredded meat pieces, moist with fibrous texture, mixed among the grain on the right side, about 4 cm by 2 cm total, slight browning at edges | 35
ITEM 5 | Dark green wilted leafy greens with glossy sheen and darker folded edges, small pile in the center-right, about 4 cm by 3 cm and 1 cm high, sitting beside the grain | 15
ITEM 6 | Pale yellow hard grated-looking cheese shards, flaky and irregular triangular slivers with slightly crumbly edges, dry surface, scattered across the lower center of the plate, about 7 cm by 5 cm total and 0.5 cm thick | 25
